# Investopedia

> Investopedia is a financial education and news site covering investing, personal finance, markets, economics, and financial product reviews.

Investopedia publishes explainers, tutorials, dictionary entries, calculators, current market news, and expert reviews of brokers, banks, credit cards, and other financial products. Its content spans beginner education through advanced investing, trading, retirement, tax, and economic topics.

## Core Hubs
- [Investing](https://www.investopedia.com/investing-4427685): Central hub for investing concepts, asset classes, portfolio strategy, and market participation.
- [Personal Finance](https://www.investopedia.com/personal-finance-4427760): Hub for budgeting, banking, credit, loans, insurance, taxes, and everyday money decisions.
- [Trading](https://www.investopedia.com/trading-4427766): Overview of trading strategies, technical analysis, instruments, and active market approaches.
- [Retirement Planning](https://www.investopedia.com/retirement-planning-4689695): Guides to retirement accounts, income planning, Social Security, and withdrawal strategies.
- [Economy](https://www.investopedia.com/economy-4689801): Coverage of macroeconomics, policy, inflation, employment, and economic indicators.
- [News](https://www.investopedia.com/news-4427706): Financial news hub with market-moving developments, company updates, and economic coverage.
- [Reviews](https://www.investopedia.com/reviews-4689740): Editorial reviews and rankings for brokers, banks, lenders, and financial tools.
- [Financial Terms Dictionary](https://www.investopedia.com/financial-term-dictionary-4769738): Alphabetical glossary of investing, finance, accounting, and economics definitions.

## Investing
- [How to Start Investing](https://www.investopedia.com/articles/basics/11/3-s-simple-investing.asp): Beginner-friendly introduction to building an investment plan and getting started.
- [Stocks](https://www.investopedia.com/stocks-4427785): Explanations of stock investing, valuation, dividends, and equity market basics.
- [Bonds](https://www.investopedia.com/bonds-4689778): Guides to bond types, yields, risks, pricing, and fixed-income investing.
- [ETFs](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/e/etf.asp): Definition and overview of exchange-traded funds, structure, benefits, and risks.
- [Mutual Funds](https://www.investopedia.com/mutual-funds-4427787): Coverage of fund types, fees, performance, and portfolio use cases.
- [Asset Allocation](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/a/assetallocation.asp): Explains portfolio diversification across asset classes and risk profiles.
- [Value Investing](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/v/valueinvesting.asp): Overview of buying undervalued securities using fundamental analysis.
- [Fundamental Analysis](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/f/fundamentalanalysis.asp): Introduction to evaluating companies using financial statements and business metrics.

## Trading
- [Technical Analysis](https://www.investopedia.com/technical-analysis-4689657): Hub for chart patterns, indicators, momentum, and price-action methods.
- [Day Trading](https://www.investopedia.com/articles/trading/05/011705.asp): Introductory guide to day trading mechanics, risks, and common strategies.
- [Swing Trading](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/s/swingtrading.asp): Definition and framework for capturing short- to medium-term price moves.
- [Options Trading](https://www.investopedia.com/options-basics-tutorial-4583012): Basics of calls, puts, pricing, and common options strategies.
- [Futures](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/f/futures.asp): Definition of futures contracts and how they are used for speculation and hedging.
- [Candlestick Charting](https://www.investopedia.com/trading/candlestick-charting-what-is-it/): Explains candlestick patterns and how traders interpret market sentiment.
- [Relative Strength Index (RSI)](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/r/rsi.asp): Definition and use of RSI as a momentum oscillator.
- [Moving Average Convergence Divergence (MACD)](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/m/macd.asp): Overview of the MACD indicator for trend and momentum analysis.

## Personal Finance
- [Budgeting Basics](https://www.investopedia.com/budgeting-and-savings-4689827): Guides to budgeting methods, saving habits, and cash-flow management.
- [Banking](https://www.investopedia.com/banking-4427755): Coverage of checking, savings, CDs, online banks, and account features.
- [Credit Cards](https://www.investopedia.com/credit-cards-4689734): Educational content and reviews for rewards, balance transfer, and secured cards.
- [Loans](https://www.investopedia.com/loans-4689743): Explanations of personal loans, mortgages, auto loans, and borrowing costs.
- [Insurance](https://www.investopedia.com/insurance-4427784): Guides to life, health, auto, home, and disability insurance.
- [Taxes](https://www.investopedia.com/taxes-4427725): Tax planning, filing, deductions, credits, and IRS-related explainers.
- [Student Loans](https://www.investopedia.com/student-loans-4689747): Coverage of federal and private student loans, repayment, and forgiveness.
- [Debt Management](https://www.investopedia.com/debt-management-4689741): Strategies for paying down debt and improving financial stability.

## Retirement
- [IRA](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/i/ira.asp): Definition and rules for individual retirement accounts and contribution basics.
- [Roth IRA](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/r/rothira.asp): Explains Roth IRA eligibility, tax treatment, and withdrawal rules.
- [401(k) Plan](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/1/401kplan.asp): Overview of employer-sponsored retirement plans, matches, and contribution limits.
- [Social Security](https://www.investopedia.com/social-security-4689818): Guides to benefits, claiming strategies, taxes, and eligibility.
- [Required Minimum Distribution (RMD)](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/r/requiredminimumdistribution.asp): Definition and rules for mandatory retirement account withdrawals.
- [Retirement Planning Guide](https://www.investopedia.com/retirement-planning-guide-5204247): Broader planning resource for saving, investing, and retirement income.
- [Pension Plan](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/p/pensionplan.asp): Definition and explanation of traditional defined-benefit retirement plans.

## Economics & Markets
- [Inflation](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/i/inflation.asp): Definition, causes, measurement, and effects of inflation on consumers and investors.
- [Consumer Price Index (CPI)](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/c/consumerpriceindex.asp): Explains CPI methodology and its role in tracking inflation.
- [Federal Reserve System](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/f/federalreservesystem.asp): Overview of the U.S. central bank and monetary policy functions.
- [Interest Rates](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/i/interestrate.asp): Definition of interest rates and their impact on borrowing and investing.
- [Gross Domestic Product (GDP)](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/g/gdp.asp): Definition and interpretation of GDP as a core economic indicator.
- [Unemployment Rate](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/u/unemploymentrate.asp): Explains unemployment measurement and labor market significance.
- [Recession](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/r/recession.asp): Definition of recession and common economic signals associated with downturns.
- [Bull Market](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/b/bullmarket.asp): Definition of sustained rising markets and investor sentiment.
- [Bear Market](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/b/bearmarket.asp): Definition of prolonged market declines and associated risk conditions.

## Reviews & Product Rankings
- [Best Online Brokers](https://www.investopedia.com/best-online-brokers-4587872): Ranked reviews of brokerage platforms for investing and trading.
- [Best Robo-Advisors](https://www.investopedia.com/best-robo-advisors-4693125): Comparison of automated investing platforms, fees, and portfolio features.
- [Best High-Yield Savings Accounts](https://www.investopedia.com/best-high-yield-savings-accounts-4770633): Editorial picks for savings accounts with competitive APYs and features.
- [Best CD Rates](https://www.investopedia.com/best-cd-rates-4770214): Comparison of certificates of deposit by term, yield, and account requirements.
- [Best Personal Loans](https://www.investopedia.com/best-personal-loans-5070337): Ranked lenders for personal loans based on rates, terms, and borrower fit.
- [Best Mortgage Lenders](https://www.investopedia.com/best-mortgage-lenders-5077012): Reviews of mortgage providers for home purchase and refinancing.
- [Best Credit Cards](https://www.investopedia.com/best-credit-cards-5076124): Comparison of top cards by rewards, fees, and use case.
- [Best Life Insurance Companies](https://www.investopedia.com/best-life-insurance-companies-4845858): Reviews of insurers based on policy options, pricing, and service.

## Calculators & Tools
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://www.investopedia.com/mortgage-calculator-5084761): Calculates monthly mortgage payments using loan amount, rate, and term.
- [Loan Calculator](https://www.investopedia.com/loan-calculator-5104934): Estimates monthly payments, total interest, and amortization for loans.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://www.investopedia.com/compound-interest-calculator-5185351): Projects investment growth using compounding and recurring contributions.
- [Retirement Calculator](https://www.investopedia.com/retirement-calculator-5089986): Estimates retirement savings needs and future income scenarios.
- [Required Minimum Distribution Calculator](https://www.investopedia.com/required-minimum-distribution-calculator-5189636): Calculates estimated RMD amounts for retirement accounts.
- [Social Security Calculator](https://www.investopedia.com/social-security-calculator-5213533): Estimates Social Security benefits under different claiming assumptions.
- [Budget Calculator](https://www.investopedia.com/budget-calculator-5189720): Helps organize income and expenses into a working budget.
- [Debt Payoff Calculator](https://www.investopedia.com/debt-payoff-calculator-5189717): Models debt repayment timelines and payoff strategies.

## Financial Terms Dictionary
- [Alpha](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/a/alpha.asp): Definition of alpha as risk-adjusted excess investment return.
- [Beta](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/b/beta.asp): Definition of beta as a measure of market-related volatility.
- [Capital Gains](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/c/capitalgain.asp): Explains profits from asset sales and related tax treatment.
- [Dividend](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/d/dividend.asp): Definition of dividend payments and common dividend-related concepts.
- [Expense Ratio](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/e/expenseratio.asp): Definition of annual fund operating costs charged to investors.
- [Net Present Value (NPV)](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/n/npv.asp): Definition of NPV for valuing future cash flows in today’s dollars.
- [Price-to-Earnings Ratio (P/E)](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/p/price-earningsratio.asp): Explains a common valuation metric for comparing stocks.
- [Sharpe Ratio](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/s/sharperatio.asp): Definition of risk-adjusted return using portfolio volatility.

## News & Analysis
- [Latest News](https://www.investopedia.com/news-4427706): Main news page for current coverage of markets, companies, and the economy.
- [Markets News](https://www.investopedia.com/markets-news-4427704): News focused on stocks, bonds, commodities, and market developments.
- [Company News](https://www.investopedia.com/company-news-4427703): Coverage of earnings, corporate actions, and business developments.
- [Economic News](https://www.investopedia.com/economic-news-4427702): Reporting on inflation, rates, jobs, and macroeconomic releases.
- [Political News](https://www.investopedia.com/political-news-5116294): Coverage of government actions affecting markets, taxes, and the economy.
- [Live Markets](https://www.investopedia.com/live-markets-5111956): Real-time market blog and rolling updates on major financial events.

## Education & Tutorials
- [Investing Basics](https://www.investopedia.com/investing-essentials-4689754): Foundational lessons for new investors on accounts, assets, and risk.
- [Stock Basics Tutorial](https://www.investopedia.com/university/stocks/): Structured tutorial on stock market concepts and investing terminology.
- [Options Basics Tutorial](https://www.investopedia.com/options-basics-tutorial-4583012): Step-by-step introduction to options contracts and core strategies.
- [Economics Basics](https://www.investopedia.com/economics-basics-tutorial-4583011): Introductory tutorial on macroeconomic and microeconomic principles.
- [Accounting Basics](https://www.investopedia.com/accounting-basics-4689736): Educational resource on financial statements and accounting concepts.
- [Technical Analysis Basic Education](https://www.investopedia.com/university/technical/): Tutorial series on charting, indicators, and trading signals.
- [Excel for Finance](https://www.investopedia.com/excel-for-finance-4689749): Guides for using Excel functions and models in financial analysis.
